Name: Mouse Side Buttons Binding
Author: khalil886
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Mouse Side Buttons lets you bind any action in the vanilla [b]Options → Controls[/b] menu to your mouse's side buttons ([b]X1 / X2[/b]) or [b]middle button[/b], exactly like a keyboard key.

Stardew Valley's keybinding structure has no field for a side button:

[/color]
[code]
public struct InputButton
{
    public Keys key;        // keyboard
    public bool mouseLeft;  // left click
    public bool mouseRight;  // right click
}[/code][color=#D4D4D8]
Because of that, the vanilla Controls screen physically cannot receive a side-button press, and no amount of config editing will bind one. This mod closes that gap.

It binds [b]nothing[/b] by default — you decide what each button does.

[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
把星露谷原生的「[b]选项 → 控制[/b]」界面里的任意操作，绑定到鼠标[b]侧键（X1 / X2）[/b]或[b]中键[/b]，就像绑定一个普通键盘按键一样。

原版的按键数据结构（InputButton）只有键盘键、鼠标左键、鼠标右键三个字段，装不下侧键，所以原版设置界面根本收不到侧键按下，改任何配置都绑不上。本模组补上了这个缺口。

它[b]默认不绑定任何按键[/b]，绑什么完全由你决定。[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Requirements first:[/b] SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer.

[/color]
[list=1]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] if you have not already.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the downloaded archive so that you get this folder:[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/MouseSideButtons/[/code][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI ([b]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b], or via Steam if you set it up that way).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]That's it — no configuration needed.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Optional:[/b] if the buttons do not work, open[/color]
[code]Mods/MouseSideButtons/config.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8]and set[/color]
[code]"DebugLog": true[/code][color=#D4D4D8], then check the SMAPI console.

[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]前置要求：[/b]SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高版本。

[/color]
[list=1]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]（如果还没装）。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]解压压缩包，使目录结构为：[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/MouseSideButtons/[/code][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏（[b]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b]，或按你平时的 SMAPI 启动方式）。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]完成，无需任何配置。[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]可选：[/b]如果侧键不生效，把[/color]
[code]Mods/MouseSideButtons/config.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8]里的[/color]
[code]"DebugLog"[/code][color=#D4D4D8]改成[/color]
[code]true[/code][color=#D4D4D8]，然后查看 SMAPI 控制台。[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Bind anything to a side button.[/b] In [b]Options → Controls[/b], click the set button next to any action and simply press your side button. The action immediately shows [i]Mouse Side Button X1[/i] / [i]Mouse Side Button X2[/i] / [i]Middle Click[/i].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Works for every control-driven action:[/b] use tool, action, menu, map, journal, inventory slots, toolbar swap, movement, emote, run, and so on.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Works in the world and inside menus.[/b] Open the map with a side button, and close it with the same button. Same for inventory and menu navigation.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Binds nothing by default.[/b] No key is taken from you until you assign one, and the game's normal "already in use" check still applies.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Clean uninstall.[/b] Delete the folder; leftover bindings simply never trigger.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[line]


[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]任意操作都能绑到侧键。[/b]在「[b]选项 → 控制[/b]」里点任意操作右边的设置按钮，然后按一下你的侧键，该操作会立刻显示「鼠标侧键 X1」/「鼠标侧键 X2」/「鼠标中键」。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]对所有由控制设置驱动的操作生效：[/b]使用工具、交互、菜单、地图、日志、物品栏槽位、切换工具栏、移动、表情、跑步等。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]游戏世界内和菜单内都生效。[/b]用侧键开地图，也能用同一个侧键关掉；背包、菜单导航同理。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]默认不绑定任何按键。[/b]你不绑它就不占键，原版的「该键已被占用」检测依然有效。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]卸载干净。[/b]直接删文件夹即可，残留的绑定不会再触发任何动作。[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Required:[/b]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Notes:[/b]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Windows only.[/b] The mod uses Windows-specific input handling.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]No other mods are required. It does not conflict with mods that only add their own configurable keys.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If you use a gaming mouse, make sure your vendor software (Logitech G HUB, Razer Synapse, etc.) reports the side buttons as the standard [b]Mouse Button 4 / 5[/b] — if they are mapped to a macro or "browser back/forward", the game never sees them.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]必需：[/b]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]星露谷物语 1.6 或更高版本[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]说明：[/b]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]仅支持 Windows。[/b]本模组使用了 Windows 特有的输入处理。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]不需要其他模组，也不会与「只添加自己配置按键」的模组冲突。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]如果你用的是游戏鼠标，请确保厂商驱动（罗技 G HUB、雷蛇 Synapse 等）把侧键识别为标准[b]「鼠标按键 4 / 5」[/b]。如果被映射成宏或「浏览器后退/前进」，游戏根本收不到这个键。[/color][/*]
[/list]
